comments.note: log-resolver.test.ts uses utimes() to manipulate file mtimes for archiveCompletedLogs/resolveLogSource tests. This is reliable on tmpfs but on systems with coarse mtime resolution (1s) a 5000ms offset was chosen to ensure stable comparisons — a test-level constant (e.g. MTIME_OFFSET_MS = 5000) could improve readability.

run-log-handlers.test.ts previously used a single tempDir variable shared between handleListRunLogs and handleGetRunLog suites. The refactor to separate logsDir/orchestratorLogsDir per suite eliminates a potential source of test pollution and is cleaner.

comments.note: mtime-based tests (archiveCompletedLogs + resolveLogSource) use a 5000ms utimes() offset. Developer noted this could use a named constant MTIME_OFFSET_MS for readability. Confirmed reliable: 3 consecutive runs produced 76/76 passes with sub-200ms test duration — no flakiness risk.

The 'logsDir entry takes precedence over orchestratorLogsDir for same filename' test in run-log-handlers.test.ts verifies merge priority by writing an active-looking file to orchestratorLogsDir and a completed file to logsDir, then asserting is_active: false (archive wins). This is a good regression guard for the deduplication priority logic.

No test currently covers the scenario where orchestratorLogsDir does not exist (as a directory). findRunLogs() is already tested for a nonexistent path returning [], but an integration-level test for handleListRunLogs() with a nonexistent orchestratorLogsDir path could add belt-and-suspenders confidence. Not a blocker — the unit-level coverage is sufficient.
